scores.tell: Soft airbrushed gradient on the binocular body with a metallic sheen. Shadows are gentle and the form turn is mushy. It lacks the crisp light-to-shadow turn of the real cards.
The pier planks and posts are fairly flat, with mild shadow depth. Contact shadow is weak where the posts meet the water. Highlights are soft, which is close to the real cards.
Broad soft highlight on the planet, a clean smooth form turn, and gentle shadow under the ring. Matches the real cards' smoothness. Little to fault.
The ball's form turn is smooth, but the panel shading is slightly leathery and painterly. The grass cast shadow is soft and the lighting is a bit flat and realistic.
Smooth plastic-like shading on the calculator with soft highlights on the keys and a clean core shadow. Close to the real card, with no obvious tell.
The big sharp glossy hot spot on the visor edges toward a glossy statue look. The rest of the form turn is smooth and the cast shadow is good.
Rope has fine texture-like highlights along the twist. Otherwise the soft form turn and the lack of a cast shadow fit the real cards.
The leather boot is a little realistic, with stitching and crinkle shading. The shadow side is deeper and the highlights are broad, like the grade 4 boot. It has no contact shadow.
The hat has smooth shading, but the dark body has little form contrast. The brim's shadow gradient is a bit muddy and the highlights are weak.

The golf club has airbrushed metal gradients and the ball's dimples are lightly shaded. The grass is soft and flat with little defined shadow. It reads as a painted scene rather than the modeled forms of real cards.
